annotations.title: Keep an image for a document

description: Keeps an image whose bytes you have (one you made, or a small file you can read) and returns its link, to use as or CSS url() in render_pdf, render_template, open_in_editor and update_document — instead of a data: URI, so the document stays small when you read it back. You send the bytes as base64 text, so this is for small images (a logo, an icon: tens of KB); PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF, at most 10 MB. A picture the person has (their photo, their logo file): ask them to add it in the editor at the edit link — drag it onto the page — and read it back with get_document. An image at a public https address needs no upload: use that address. An SVG goes into the HTML as it is. The image lasts 30 days after a document using it last changed.

image_base64.description: The image's bytes, base64 (a data: URI is taken too).

name: upload_image
